flags.why: This is a current word for uncooperative behaviour, including in [educational writing](https://pes.htu.edu.vn/pes.htu.edu.vn/pes.htu.edu.vn/nghien-cuu/109-phối-hợp-giữa-nhà-trường-và-gia-đình-trong-tư-vấn-hỗ-trợ-học-tập-cho-học-sinh-tiểu-học-hiện-nay).
Refusing to cooperate is a current use, not a dated one, as illustrated by [parents refusing to cooperate with teachers](https://cadn.com.vn/phu-huynh-ca-biet-post148105.html).
The noun denotes ordinary non-cooperation today, so dated and rare misleadingly discourage its use.
Kí lô is used nationwide, and a [dialect study](https://daotao.ued.udn.vn/wp-content/uploads/2023/11/LUAN-AN_sao-mai_BAN-IN-BV-CAP-TRUONG-28.11.pdf) explicitly treats ki lô as the national form.

In the rooster comparison, cồ means large, while lóng ngóng supplies the clumsiness; [the dictionary entry](https://vtudien.com/viet-viet/dictionary/nghia-cua-tu-cồ) does not support this supposed sense.

The word means counterrevolutionary or opposed to the revolution, rather than naming a counterrevolution, as shown by [its dictionary definition](https://vtudien.com/viet-viet/dictionary/nghia-cua-tu-phản%20cách%20mạng).
flags.fix: adj | counterrevolutionary; opposed to the revolution

flags.why: The example defines the headword instead of showing it in use.
flags.fix: Họ bị buộc tội hoạt động phản cách mạng. = They were accused of counterrevolutionary activities.
